title: nextflow-rna-methy-omics-data-analysis pipeline parameters
description: Nextflow SeekGene RNA-MET data analysis pipeline

input_output_options.title: Input/output options
input_output_options.description: Define where the pipeline should find input data and save output data.

outdir.description: The output directory where the results will be saved. You have to use absolute paths to storage on Cloud infrastructure.

workflow.title: Workflow
workflow.description: Select which sub-workflow to run. Accepted values: rna_met | methy_only | force_cell.

seeksoultools_path.description: Deprecated/unused parameter (not referenced by this pipeline).

database_dir.title: Database Directory
database_dir.description: Reference database root directory. Used to derive genomeDir/genomefa/gtf/bismark_ref/bed paths.

genomeDir.title: STAR Genome Directory
genomeDir.description: STAR index directory. If not set, derived from database_dir.

genomefa.title: Genome FASTA
genomefa.description: Genome FASTA file. If not set, derived from database_dir.

gtf.title: GTF
gtf.description: Gene annotation GTF. If not set, derived from database_dir.

bismark_ref.title: Bismark Reference Directory
bismark_ref.description: Bismark reference directory. If not set, derived from database_dir.

chrom_size_path_full.title: Chrom Sizes (Full)
chrom_size_path_full.description: Chromosome size BED path (full). If not set, derived from database_dir.

chrom_size_path.title: Chrom Sizes
chrom_size_path.description: Chromosome size BED path. If not set, derived from database_dir (prefers chr_nochrM.bed when exists).

cbcsv.title: Cell Barcode CSV
cbcsv.description: Cell barcode whitelist CSV. Default depends on chemistry.

chemistry.title: Chemistry
chemistry.description: Library chemistry. Controls defaults for exp_chemistry and cbcsv.

exp_chemistry.title: Expression Chemistry
exp_chemistry.description: Expression chemistry. If not set, derived from chemistry.

split_fastq.description: Split FASTQ into N chunks. Use 0 to disable splitting.

barcode_engine.description: Barcode extraction engine for METHYLATION_BARCODE_EXTRACTION. 'rust' uses the prebuilt barcode-extract binary; 'python' uses barcode_cs_multi.py (fallback).

expected_cell_num.title: Expected Cell Number
expected_cell_num.description: Expected number of cells used by methy_only to estimate the filtered barcode set.

project.title: Project Name
project.description: Project name. If empty, inferred from outdir in rna_met/methy_only.

pre_analysis_path.title: Pre-analysis Path
pre_analysis_path.description: Required for force_cell workflow. Can be a local path or an OSS URI (oss://...).

pre_outdir.title: Pre-analysis Outdir
pre_outdir.description: Optional for force_cell workflow. If not set, derived from pre_analysis_path.

sample.title: Samples
sample.description: Samples to force (comma-separated), used by force_cell workflow.

oss_endpoint.title: OSS Endpoint
oss_endpoint.description: OSS endpoint for Alibaba Cloud object storage downloads.

force_cell_number.title: Force Cell Number
force_cell_number.description: Force-cell map. Provide either a JSON object (recommended) or a JSON string. Example: {"sampleA": 5000, "sampleB": 6000}.
